blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) had no overdue pending Freedom of Information (FOI) requests from Jan. 31, 2017, to June 30, 2026. In a statement, the NTC said the FOI Program Management Office had named it among the government agencies that consistently complied with the FOI Program over the period. READ: NTC recognized as ‘Freedom of Information Champion’ Since 2018, it has also ranked among the most requested and top-performing agencies on the electronic Freedom of Information (eFOI) portal.
